findings.evidence: The interactive example uses `timeout --foreground 1800 gemini`, omitting the forced-termination fallback specified under Defaults. If Gemini ignores SIGTERM, this branch can remain running beyond its intended bound.
findings.fix: Change the interactive example to `timeout --foreground --kill-after=10s 1800 gemini ...`, preserving terminal access while enforcing the same TERM-to-KILL fallback as the headless examples.
